title: cyclosorus serra
intro: Cyclosorus serra, commonly known as the serrated fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat a variety of health issues. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever, relieving pain, and improving circulation. The bioactive constituents of Cyclosorus serra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
